purpose: Teach: 小川/右側/パーツ/コンパクト/ストア/キャッシュ/漁業/五輪

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、近所の、本気で、絶対、小川、絶対、で、絶対、私たち、絶対、よく、絶対、遊んだよね
lines.en: You know, Riku — we used to play by that little stream near your place all the time.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice lifts slightly on his name. Warm memory filtered through teenage distance. Trails off gently, like she's surprised herself by remembering.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。教室の、本気で、絶対、右側、絶対、お前の席、絶対、なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. You sat right next to me in homeroom, remember?
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Steady, grounded tone. Small pause before her name — like he's choosing to say it, not just filling space. Genuine recall, not performing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、パソコンの、絶対、パーツ、絶対、詳しいよね、リク
lines.en: You were always so into computers and parts and all that. You really knew your stuff.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no irony mask. Direct eye-contact energy. Warm but not overplayed. Slight emphasis on 「knew」 like she's still impressed by it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の筆箱、本気for、絶対、コンパクト、絶対、で、絶対、便利だよな、桜
lines.en: And your pencil case — it was so compact and practical. I always thought that was cool.
lines.style: Tender observation. Almost thinking aloud. Small, genuine smile in the voice. Not trying to impress, just noticing something real about him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: コンビニ、本気で、絶対、ストア、絶対、新しいの、絶対、できたよね、リク
lines.en: Did you see they opened a new convenience store near there?
lines.style: Lighter energy, slightly brighter. Brings him back to the present moment. Casual bridge between memory and now. Not forcing it — just a natural conversation turn.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、キャッシュ、絶対、で、絶対、もらうの?桜
lines.en: Do you still get your allowance in cash, or has that changed?
lines.style: Genuine question, not small talk. Slightly curious tilt. Testing whether things have shifted between them or if some threads still hold.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地理で、本気で、絶対、漁業、絶対、習ったよね、リク
lines.en: Remember in geography class when we learned about the fishing industry around there?
lines.style: Reflective, turning inward. Like she's pulling another thread from memory. Soft, wondering tone. Less direct than before — almost to herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、五輪、絶対、応援、絶対、行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: We should go back sometime. Cheer on the Olympics together like we said we would.
lines.style: Opening with warmth and a gentle forward lean. Hopeful but careful — not presuming. The 「we」 carries weight. Ends with quiet conviction, not pressure.
